en: Color postcard with a collage of three photographs on an orange background. The largest circular image shows a central square of a historic city with a domed former mosque, surrounding Baroque buildings, a column-like monument in the square, parked cars, and hills in the distance. Two smaller rectangular photos show modern high‑rise apartment blocks and a commercial building in a newly developed district. The word "PÉCS" is printed on the front. The reverse side has handwritten text in blue ink, address lines, postage area with a Hungarian stamp featuring peaches and the inscription "MAGYAR POSTA 2 Ft", and printed publishing information.
